project_signals.summary: Keep Maximum HP an ordinary defensive stat and gravity an ordinary dangerous mechanic; story leverage should come from how the player understands and combines normal rules, not from a replacement secret class.
Use LitRPG mechanics as causal pressure while relationships, trust, belonging, rivalry, status, and social consequence carry substantial dramatic weight.
Favor character-legible fantasy and romance readability over stat-sheet density or system exposition for its own sake.
Do not let numerical optimization or mechanical explanation replace scenes that change character, relationship, danger, status, or choice.
Keep pre-existing-connection and experimentation-grown romance paths alive until performed behavior gives a reason to converge.
A gravity accident may create access to a higher-level place or social layer, but it should not erase the competence, danger, or social costs of being underprepared.
